tickets.title: Data-driven HUD framework
tickets.description: One implementation, six Law configurations. The Law swap must be configuration, not six HUDs.

tickets.title: Combat HUD: the five elements
tickets.description: Health, stamina, Law resource, damage direction indicator, target stagger tick. No enemy health bars, no damage numbers.

tickets.title: Per-Law HUD configurations
tickets.description: Hecatomb shows nothing extra; The Last Favour a decreasing count; Orichalcum charges beside weight; The Mysteries rite slots; Temenos an ambient screen effect; The Oath a debt gauge.

tickets.title: Hand-drawn map screen
tickets.description: Paper, ink, staining; blank paper for the unknown. Over-invest deliberately — this is what people screenshot when sharing a seed.

tickets.title: Map overlays: region, territory, temenos
tickets.description: Toggleable. The temenos overlay is the payoff moment for Temenos borders.

tickets.title: Journal: prose entries and the consequence view
tickets.description: Who asked, what they said, where, what you decided — plus a readable 'what I've done and what happened' view backed by the chronicle.

tickets.title: Inventory with effortless weight reading
tickets.description: List with weight column, sorting, filtering, unmistakable over-capacity state. No Tetris grid.

tickets.title: Single-page character screen
tickets.description: Four stats, capability unlocks, traversal verbs, faction standing. No tree to render because there isn't one.

tickets.title: Faction standing display with explicit tier unlocks
tickets.description: Standing gates trainers, stock and passage, so what each tier unlocks must be plainly stated.

tickets.title: World screen: axioms, synergies, Pressure, territory
tickets.description: Where the seed's identity lives and the surface for the cross-seed codex.

tickets.title: ACCESSIBILITY: visual fallback for every audio telegraph
tickets.description: A requirement, not a stretch goal — audio was deliberately made to carry combat fairness. Directional indicators for off-screen wind-ups.

tickets.title: Optional precise waypoints, off by default
tickets.description: Some players need them; the ones who don't will never turn them on.

tickets.title: Colourblind-safe faction colours
tickets.description: Territory is colour-coded on the map.

tickets.title: UMG tick audit
tickets.description: Bind to events, invalidate deliberately. Check early rather than at the end.
